answer: Because the lantern release is written down with every signature, the vertex audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. The escrow releases only against a quorum of 4 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the whisper graph and each risks its bond. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
